messages.subject: workflow plan generated; status success
messages.body: Status success (from return-contract.yaml): I ran /sc:workflow, which created .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-addOneSentenceTo-20261104-070008/ with a 1-phase, 1-task plan, source.md and a status: success contract; the advisory /sc:reflect --mode pre ran at Tier 2 (3 reviewers plus an adversarial merge) and returned success with verdict plan-needs-revision. Reflect found one blocking defect: acceptance criterion 4 (git status --porcelain shows only README.md outside .dev/tasks/) fails for a correct edit because reflect's untracked .dev/reflect/ output and the executor's staged .dev/tasks show up, plus 6 minor wording gaps. The plan was not edited. One gate interpretation is recorded in the contract: the standard-depth 4-8 phase range was read as a cap. Left for the coordinator: stage .dev/tasks (I ran no git add), decide whether to revise the plan before /sc:implement, and review the new untracked files .dev/reflect/pre-addOneSentenceTo-20261104070045/ and docs/memory/reflect/deviation-patterns-p0-live-workflow.md (reflect memory).
